notes.title: Patch 1.06 - added Hardcore mode and quest reset option
notes.content:
[p][b]Gameplay/balance[/b]

-Hardcore mode permadeath is now available.

-If the player completes quest 13 (Ra quest) and has level 95, players can reset the quest list for 5000 gold and replay all quests on Nightmare or Hell difficult.

-The player can no longer play on normal difficulty if it hits level 95.

-You can now enter the Ra and Elemental King quest area at level 85 minimum.

[strike]-Nightmare difficulty is available from a minimum of previous level 30 to level 60 now

-Hell difficulty is available from a minimum of previous level 70 to level 95 now.[/strike]

[b]Items:[/b]

-Added 4 new unique items
-You can now gamble weapons.

[b]Item drop rate:[/b]

-Steelmoor wilderness loot pool level 1 drops decreased.[/p][p][/p][p]edit: [/p][p]Patch 1.06b[/p][p]-Fixed an auto-aim bug that sometimes happened when returning a quest item to an NPC. [/p][p][/p][p]edit:

Patch 1.06c[/p][p]-Nightmare and Hell Difficulty are now only available from level 95 due to drop rate balance.[/p][p]-Some map mistakes fixed in Glacial Plateau[/p][p]-Spelling mistakes fixed[/p][p]-Increased stats on some monsters in the Glacial Plateau[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.04 – Fixed bugs, animations and game balance.
notes.content: [p][b]bug fixes and tweaks:[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]-Sound menu bugs fixed; sound would sometimes spike on swapping menu screens.[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where player health did not update correctly upon gaining a level and wearing items that  added health[/p][p]-Fixed a bug where health sometimes would not update properly on area/level switch[/p][p]-Fixed some object-popping bugs in Steelmoor Town[/p][p]-Fixed Blood Summoner globe ball spell with health bar glitch on monsters[/p][p]-Lizard monster-type walk animations improved; the animations were too slow.[/p][p]-Town Thief attack animations improved[/p][p][/p][p][b]Drop rate:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]-Uber Alcana drop rate increased for Uber Goro scroll[/p][p][/p][p][b]Game balance:[/b][/p][p][/p][p]-Some monsters in higher-level areas have upgraded stats and increased difficulty.[/p][p]-Royal Woods and Bandit Woods no longer scale health based on player level for monsters, except for       quest monsters. [/p][p]-Some monsters in the Chaos Realm have their level increased for better XP.[/p][p]-Town Thief monster level increased from 35 to 40.[/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: -Sound menu bugs fixed; sound would sometimes spike on swapping menu screens.
-Fixed a bug where player health did not update correctly upon gaining a level and wearing items that  added health
-Fixed a bug where health sometimes would not update properly on area/level switch
-Fixed some object-popping bugs in Steelmoor Town
-Fixed Blood Summoner globe ball spell with health bar glitch on monsters
-Lizard monster-type walk animations improved; the animations were too slow.
-Town Thief attack animations improved

tags.balance_change: -Uber Alcana drop rate increased for Uber Goro scroll
-Some monsters in higher-level areas have upgraded stats and increased difficulty.
-Royal Woods and Bandit Woods no longer scale health based on player level for monsters, except for       quest monsters.
-Some monsters in the Chaos Realm have their level increased for better XP.
-Town Thief monster level increased from 35 to 40.
